sources.quote: 外形寸法 260mm（幅）×230mm（奥行き）×83mm（高さ）
セット内容：セガサターン本体／セガサターン コントロールパッド1個／ステレオAVケーブル／

conflicts.reason: Maker's own manual in millimetres beats a museum record rounded to whole inches; the CHM unit is also the NA build (MK-80000).

notes: Primary: Sega Enterprises' 1994 Japanese instruction manual for the HST-3200 (取扱説明書 セガサターン, part 672-2541A), scanned on archive.org item 'sega-saturn-instruction-manuals', file '(1994) Sega Saturn Instruction Manual (Sega)(JP).pdf', PDF page 1 (定格 block). The scan's OCR text layer is garbled on this line ('2bOmm ( 宮 xeomm (St) x 3mm'), so the quote is our transcription of the printed line from the page image, checked at 4x zoom; axes as Sega labels them: 幅 width 260, 奥行き depth 230, 高さ height 83.

Conflict: CHM 102674790 (NA Saturn, model numbers MK-80000 / MK-80100, 1994; the record is the unit with pad and cables, no box) prints '10w x 3h x 9l (in)' / '25.4w x 7.62h x 22.86l (cm)', whole-inch figures. The maker's millimetre figure is chosen.
Mass: none in the manual; CHM '3 (lb)' is whole-pound and not used.

Uncovered: media (the manual's drawings show a CD door and a cartridge slot but no labelled complete list was transcribed); ports (the rear figure on PDF page 3 labels 拡張スロット, 電源端子, AV出力端子, 拡張通信端子; front controller ports are not in that figure). Controls not transcribed.
Sega's own hardware archive (www.sega.jp/fb/segahard/...) refuses automated fetches (403) and was not used; it needs a human browser visit.
external_ids: Wikidata Q200912 confirmed through the Wikidata API; igdb_platform 'saturn' is Wikidata's P5795 on that item.
